name: mapping_deep_nesting_at_boundary_stays_object
description: MAX_JSON_DEPTH is 10 (src/provider/mod.rs). put stores an 11-level-deep {"n": ...} chain; the depth guard in Value::from_json_at checks `depth >= MAX_JSON_DEPTH` before recursing into an Object/Array, where depth starts at 0 for the field's own top-level value. Walking 9 more '.n' hops from the field lands on the value processed at depth 9 (< 10), which stays a real nested object whose own "n" field is where the boundary bites (see mapping_deep_nesting_past_boundary_flattens_to_text).
